name: MCG-05-14-012 (Hubble)
blurb: MCG-05-14-012, a lenticular galaxy with an active nucleus, seen by Hubble.
label: mcg0514012-hubble
story: At the heart of this galaxy is an active nucleus, a feeding black hole picked out by Swift's hard X-ray survey. Hubble looked here to study how the gas around a galaxy's center connects to its black hole's activity.

claims.text: MCG-05-14-012 is a target of Hubble program 15181 with a Seyfert nucleus
The program studies the connection between circumnuclear gas and nuclear black hole activity
In the LLAMA survey, MCG-05-14-12 is in the AGN sample with morphology S0 (lenticular)
The LLAMA AGN sample was selected from the Swift-BAT hard X-ray survey
MCG-05-14-012 is also known as ESO 424-12
